# Code used for the analysis and graphs

## 1. Regressions
General form of the regression: 
judgment ~ group_type*question_type + (1|participant)

### 1. A. Group 1 (Relevance training) vs. Group 2 (Irrelevance training)
```{r}
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)

# Load the data from CSV
data <- read.csv('data/study2_cleaned_data.csv')

# filter Groups 1 and 2
data <- subset(data, Group %in% c(1, 2))

# convert factors to numeric codes
# Group 1 is Relevance training, Group 2 is Irrelevance training
data$group_type <- ifelse(data$Group == 1, -0.5, 0.5) 

# Validation questions coded as -0.5, test questions as 0.5
data$question_type <- ifelse(data$is_val == 1, -0.5, 0.5)  

# Run the linear mixed-effects regression
model <- lmer(Test_Score ~ group_type * question_type + (1|Participant_id), data=data)

# Output the summary of the model
summary(model)
```


### 1. B. Group 2 (Irrelevance training) vs. Group 3 (No training)
```{r}
library(lmerTest)

data <- read.csv('data/study2_cleaned_data.csv')

# Filter out the data for Groups 2 and 3 only
data <- subset(data, Group %in% c(2, 3))

# Convert group type and question type to effect coding
# Group 2 is Irrelevance training, Group 3 is No training
data$group_type <- ifelse(data$Group == 2, -0.5, 0.5)

# Code validation questions as -0.5, test as 0.5
data$question_type <- ifelse(data$is_val == 1, -0.5, 0.5)  

# Run the linear mixed-effects regression using lmer
model <- lmer(Test_Score ~ group_type * question_type + (1|Participant_id), data=data)

# Output the summary of the model
summary(model)
```


## 2. Graph the results
```{r}
data <- read.csv('data/study2_cleaned_data.csv')

# Calculate means and 95% CIs for each group and condition
results <- data %>%
  group_by(Group, is_val) %>%
  summarize(
    mean = mean(Test_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci = qt(0.975, df = n() - 1) * sd(Test_Score, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )
results

data %>%
  filter(is_val == 0) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(n_trials = n())
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

data <- read.csv('data/study2_cleaned_data.csv')

results <- data %>%
  group_by(Group, is_val) %>%
  summarize(
    mean = mean(Test_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci = qt(0.975, df = n() - 1) * sd(Test_Score, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )

x_coords <- data.frame(
  Group = rep(1:3, each = 2),
  is_val = rep(0:1, 3),
  x_pos = c(0, 0.4, 1, 1.4, 2, 2.4)
)

results <- merge(results, x_coords, by = c("Group", "is_val"))

# Define group colors explicitly
group_colors <- c("1" = "#F8766D", "2" = "#00BA38", "3" = "#619CFF")

# Plotting
ggplot(results, aes(x = x_pos, y = mean, color = factor(Group))) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - ci, ymax = mean + ci), width = 0.1, size = 1) + 
  geom_point(aes(shape = factor(is_val)), size = 5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 18), labels = c("Test", "Validation")) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +  # ✅ Add this line
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0.2, 1.2, 2.2), labels = c("Group 1\n(Relevance Training)", "Group 2\n(Irrelevance Training)", "Group 3\n(No Training)")) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "",
    y = "Average Score\n",  
    color = "Group",
    shape = "Question Type",
    linetype = "Optimal sol."
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dotted", "dashed"), 
                        labels = c("Test", "Validation")) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(50, NA)) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +  
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, 'cm'),  
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12), 
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),  
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),  
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),   
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),   
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)  
  ) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 66.7, linetype = "Test Question solution"), color = "grey", size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 100, linetype = "Validation Question"), color = "grey", size = 1) +
  guides(
    shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),   
    color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),   
    linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE) 
  )

# Save the plot
ggsave("plots/results_plot.png", dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 8)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Load dataset
data <- read.csv('data/study2_cleaned_data.csv')

# Filter to test trials only
data <- data %>%
  filter(is_val == 0 & Group %in% c(1, 2, 3))

# Color palette for groups
group_colors <- c("1" = "#F8766D", "2" = "#00BA38", "3" = "#619CFF")

# Histogram plot
ggplot(data, aes(x = Test_Score, fill = factor(Group))) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = after_stat(count / sum(count))),
    binwidth = 5,
    center = 50,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 1.0
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Group, labeller = as_labeller(c(
    `1` = "Group 1: Relevance Training",
    `2` = "Group 2: Ireelevance Training",
    `3` = "Group 3: No Training"
  ))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "\nTest Score",
    y = "Proportion\n",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16),      # Facet title (e.g., "Group 1...")
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),       # Tick labels
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),      # Axis titles
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Optional save
ggsave("plots/histogram_test_scores.png", width = 12, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```
